title: Extend fleet/playtest-loop cohorts to claude_code and prove one paid happy path
body:
`claude_code` became drivable in the generic blind runner (run.sh launch
branch, 2026-08-30), but the cohort paths still can't use it:
`blind-tester/fleet.mjs`'s shared gate demands the codex-shaped
`--client-authority-json` record for every provider, so a claude cohort via
`playtest-loop.sh`/fleet refuses fast pre-launch (exit 42 with a clear
message). Solo `run.sh` sessions are the live path today.

To do:
1. Teach the fleet gate the claude-session authority shape (or make the
   authority record provider-generic behind the reader-module seam), so
   claude cohorts launch.
2. Exercise ONE paid happy-path claude session end to end (spawn → capture →
   envelope → verify/publish) — the launch branch is fail-closed but its
   happy path has not run against a real model.
3. Check envelope model binding against undated catalog ids (the envelope
   refuses transcript-model ≠ catalog id; `claude-opus-5`-style undated ids
   may need dating in the catalog).
4. Cosmetic: the shared verify-failure message still says "Codex".
5. Consider a job-tree kill on timeout (today relies on stdin-EOF MCP
   shutdown).

Unlocks true two-family cohorts — the corroboration threshold (≥2 distinct
families) becomes reachable at fleet scale, which is what retires the
single-vendor experience-metrics P0 (`e605134a2c956cec`) completely.
